name: Toa Baja (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and gold, the green hoist charged with two crossed keys, one gold and one silver, for the Apostle Saint Peter, patron of the town.
history: Toa Baja is a town and municipality on the northern coast of Puerto Rico. The green band represents the plains of the Toa River, now La Plata, and the golden band the sun; the crossed keys symbolise the Apostle Saint Peter, patron saint of the city. According to Flags of the World the flag was designed in 1980.

features.role: two crossed keys of Saint Peter, one gold and one silver
